name: Unearthed
source:
In this game you play as someone who has crash-landed on an alien planet. You are forced to explore the planet's surface, and the remnants of a long-dead alien civilization, in order to build a distress signal. Throughout the game you are accompanied by P.A.G.E., an AI assistant who guides you on your adventure.

[From [url=https://adrian-clayton.itch.io/unearthed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏中，你迫降在一颗外星行星上。为了建造求救信号装置，你被迫探索星球表面，以及早已灭亡的外星文明留下的遗迹。整场游戏中，人工智能助手P.A.G.E.将始终陪伴，指引你的冒险。

[摘自[url=https://adrian-clayton.itch.io/unearthed]Itch.io[/url]]
